UpdateSourceArgs: -c "if [[ -x /usr/bin/wine ]]; then WINEPREFIX=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine\" WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all /usr/bin/wineboot --init --update || exit 1; old=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.proton/compatdata/pfx/drive_c/users/steamuser\"; new=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine/drive_c/users/$(id -un)\"; if [[ -d \"$old\" && -d \"$new\" && ! -e \"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine/.proton-profile-copied\" ]]; then cp -an \"$old/.\" \"$new/\" && touch \"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine/.proton-profile-copied\" && echo \"Copied the Proton GE user profile into the Wine prefix\"; fi; for f in \"{{$FullRootDir}}.proton\"/*; do [[ \"$f\" == */compatdata ]] || rm -rf \"$f\"; done; elif [[ -x \"{{$FullRootDir}}.proton/proton\" ]]; then echo \"WARNING: Wine was not found at /usr/bin/wine, so this instance keeps running on its current Proton GE version, which is no longer updated. To switch to Wine, change a container instance's image to cubecoders/ampbase:wine-stable, or install Wine (latest stable from winehq.org) on a host without containers.\"; else echo \"ERROR: Wine was not found at /usr/bin/wine. To switch to Wine, change a container instance's image to cubecoders/ampbase:wine-stable, or install Wine (latest stable from winehq.org) on a host without containers.\"; exit 1; fi"
